newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends lower, funds and trade sells.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends lower, funds and trade sells.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures continued to back off from resistance and closed lower, pressured by fund and trade selling throughout the day, floor sources said.
Local buying lifted prices off the lows near the close.
"There is more support under the market than we realized," a floor source said.
Additional selling is expected Friday, and support remained at 73.00 cents in March.
The spot contract ended 0.70 lower at 74.65, traded 75.10 to 74.31. The back months settled 0.67 to 0.08 lower.
Floor sources said disappointment over the weekly export and sales data sparked the selloff.
The U.S. Department of Agriculture put new sales for the week ended Jan 23 at 262,100 bales, and exports at 257,200 bales, in the 1996/97 crop.
